Management of all budgets and associated reporting processes to ensure that costs are effectively managed and controlled

Responsible for the continuous development of activities including facilitation, deputation and management of reviews where necessary.

Ensure any shortfalls are identified, resolved or escalated where necessary.

Contractual Requirements – Manage and support contract reviews and ensure communication of any changes into activities as appropriate

Management and maintenance of effective working relationships with all stakeholders

d: Wealth & Retail Banking Graduate Programme 2026 (UAE Nationals)

Within the mass retail sector, our strategic focus is on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us, forming the future pipeline of affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. q: We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.

d: 📢 WE ARE HIRING – PROJECT MANAGER | FIT-OUT & INTERIORS

q: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or Project Management.
Minimum 10 years of experience in project and construction management, particularly in Fit-Out, Finishes, and Architectural Design.
Strong knowledge of UAE Fit-Out practices and construction inspection standards.
Excellent project management, leadership, communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
Solid knowledge of budgeting, material planning, financial projections, and value engineering.
Strong understanding of Quality Assurance (QA), risk management, and safety practices.
Proficiency in computer applications and project reporting.
Knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM), Management of Change (MOC), Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), and Pre-Start-up Safety Review (PSSR).

r: Manage project planning, engineering submittals, construction, and execution.
Review IFC drawings, specifications, BOQs, and scope of work; coordinate RFIs and variation notices.
Develop project plans, schedules, resource allocation, and procurement coordination.
Lead site teams, engineers, foremen, contractors, and subcontractors.
Monitor manpower productivity, material usage, procurement, and project costs.
Manage project budgets, expenditures, LPOs, subcontract agreements, and change orders.
Ensure proper coordination with clients, consultants, vendors, and relevant authorities.
